description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseStore class, which implements the Store interface for persisting monitoring metrics into a database. It includes methods for flushing metrics data by constructing and executing an SQL INSERT statement, with dependencies on other components like DBManagerFactory.

classes.name: DatabaseStore
classes.description: Implements persistent storage of tracking metrics using a configured database. Handles inserting metric data into specified database tables, ensuring proper data type conversions and handling auto-incremented IDs.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Persists the metrics from a monitor object into the database by constructing and executing an SQL INSERT statement, including type-specific data handling and ID management.
